title: Light and Dark Mindscapes
answer: The Light and Dark realms are vulnerable mind-projections, not ordinary physical worlds. Each grows a First Archive, Labyrinth, Shrine, remembered settlement, hazardous Force Font and Herald Court under a fixed server work budget. The Hollow Court and Luminous Concord periodically manifest Dark Eclipse or Whiteout: Force Pressure intensifies with distance from the first thought, empowering aligned minds and draining intruders. Defeating a realm Herald is the non-circular survival path to its mythic artifact. Entry leaves a skin-matched body behind; damage mirrors and can kill the traveller. Leaving Darkness requires its tag and level 5; leaving Light requires level 5 in either ladder. Ordinary travel cannot bypass that gate.
